name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
notes: Upper-chest bias. Delts are secondary not the point.

name: Dips
notes: Still a press. Not a pec isolation.

name: Single-Arm Shoulder Press
notes: Pecs may stabilize. Not a chest exercise.

name: Single Arm Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
aliases: Single Arm Incline Dumbbell Bench Press

name: Chin-Up
notes: Youdas 2010 pecs fire ~50% MVIC as initiators. That is not chest work. Do not debit Pectoralis.

name: Pull-up
notes: Same rule as chin-ups. No pec debit.

name: TRX T-Row
aliases: TRX T-Row;TRX T's (T-pose rows);TRX T's;TRX rows (T's);TRX rows
notes: Horizontal pull. Rear-delt overlap with face pulls is secondary.

name: TRX Y-Fly
aliases: Curtain openers (TRX Y flies);TRX Y flies (curtain-opener);TRX Y flies
notes: Lower trap / scapular upward rotation. Finisher behind face pulls.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
notes: Carries side-delt work shrugs do not.

name: Incline Hammer Curl
aliases: Incline dumbbell hammer curls;Incline Hammer Curl

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
notes: Supinated. Not comparable to hammer numbers.

name: Renegade Rows
notes: Pecs are the plank. Not a chest exercise. Do not debit Pectoralis as a target.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
notes: Rare case where pecs are a real secondary.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat (sprinter-lean)
aliases: Bulgarian split squats, sprinter-lean (torso forward, posterior-chain bias)

name: Bulgarian Split Squat (upright)
aliases: Bulgarian split squats, upright (torso perpendicular, quad bias)

name: Calf Raise
notes: Standing rule: to exhaustion. Reps often untracked.

name: Walk
notes: Not a lift. No muscle debit.
